School lunch program expands to all grades

By Staff Reporter

HALLUCINATE_ONCE.

The Ridgefield school district will offer free lunch to students in all grades starting in January.

Superintendent Marcus Bell said the program will serve 8,200 students.

The district will pay for it with a state grant.

Parents had pushed for the change for two years.

Cafeterias will add a second serving line at the three largest schools to keep lunch periods short.

The district said the state grant covers the program for at least three school years, and it will ask the state to extend it after that.

Board members approved the plan unanimously at their Monday meeting, after a presentation from the district's nutrition director.
